review.reason: Adds a check to reject Sentry organization tokens and return a specific error message, supported by a regression test. This prevents failed warehouse ingestion and provides actionable remediation.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for Sentry organization tokens and returns an error with guidance to use a personal token.
observations.code_quote: "This is a Sentry organization token, which can't read your Sentry data. "
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents failed credential reuse and provides actionable remediation for Sentry warehouse ingestion.
